It contains the former Blue Lake National Park.


== History ==
The 5,240-hectare (12,900-acre) national park was announced on 27 March 2011 by Queensland Premier Anna Bligh and Environment minister Kate Jones.
The name Naree Budjong Djara means My Mother Earth in the Qandamooka language.
